scope: All Settings.bundle plist files from supplied iOS 3.5 build 0; packaged declarations, not installed effective settings

items.title: Ad block lists
items.footer: Ad blocking is only available for premium users.

items.title: Website Annoyances (cookie banners, social media, etc.)
Enhanced ad block by language
items.footer: Ad block lists provided by https://easylist.to
Only select this if customer service has directed you to do this. This will slow down the application and consume storage space.

items.title: Block all pop-ups
items.description: Ignore pop-ups, even user initiated ones.

items.title: Block website ads
items.description: Block some website ads. If ads aren't blocked please contact support

items.title: Block ad redirects
items.description: Block sites from redirecting you to pages that only show ads.

items.title: Block JavaScript alert dialogs
items.description: Block all JavaScript alert dialogs on the browser.

items.title: Block JavaScript confirm dialogs
items.description: Block all JavaScript confirm dialogs on the browser. This could cause issues if the website is expecting a yes or no answer from you.

items.title: Block JavaScript prompt dialogs
items.description: Block all JavaScript prompt dialogs on the browser. This could cause issues if the website is expecting information from you.

items.title: Search engine
items.description: Search engine to use when performing a search from the address bar.

items.title: Show dialog asking to restore tabs
items.description: Ask whether the app should try to restore previously opened tabs after the app was closed.

items.title: Always attempt to restore tabs
items.description: Attempt to restore tabs always, without prompting.

items.title: Prevent app from overriding user agent
items.description: On some website the app will override the user agent with one known to work better for that site. This option will prevent that.

items.title: Where to open pages from within the app
items.description: When asking to open pages from a screen other than the Web Browser itself, choose where you want those pages to open by default.

items.title: When restoring tabs also include private tabs
Prevent remembering recent media from private tabs
Open links and videos shared from other apps in a private tab
Require Face ID / Touch ID to access private tabs
Don't show dialog for video already playing
Show video played dialog
items.description: Shows a dialog a few seconds after a video was played asking if the video played correctly, allowing you to access help and submit the video for review.

items.title: Prefer TV Application
items.description: Select whether you want the app to always use the TV Receiver App over other methods such as DLNA.

items.title: Convert m3u8 videos to ts
items.description: Always convert m3u8 videos to ts without prompting. This is recommended for most dlna streaming devices.

items.title: Show Now Playing media controls on lock screen
Prevent Screen Lock
items.description: Prevent device from sleeping while a video is being routed through it.

items.title: Auto open playback control screen
items.description: Open playback control screen as soon as the video starts playing on your TV.

items.title: Disable volume buttons while casting
items.description: Volume buttons on the phone will not control the volume of your casted media. You must restart casting after changing this.

items.title: Disable thumbnail extraction
items.description: Disables the extraction of thumbnails from videos because some content providers have limits on the number of connections

items.title: Web Receiver compatibility mode
items.description: Some old browsers do not have some of the newer features of the web receiver. This will try to use features available on older receivers.

items.title: Internet Protocol Type
items.description: Selects the preferred IP protocol for receiver communication.

items.footer: When a video is downloaded from an HLS (M3U8) stream as a TS file, the system will automatically convert it back to HLS format when casting to devices that prefer that format.

items.description: Select whether the app follows the system settings, or is on light mode, or dark mode.

items.title: Reset privacy settings
items.description: Clears all prior selections for age, analytics, GDPR, app instance id, etc.

items.title: Auto play video or show list
items.description: Attempts to play the video or loads the video list as soon as some types of videos are detected.

items.title: Hide m3u8 with no audio
items.description: For adaptive m3u8 videos, the individual videos for each resolution will be hidden in the video list if the app believes they don't have audio.

items.title: Advanced video detection
items.description: Detects videos that might be a bit harder to detect by other simpler methods. Disable this if browsing is slow.

limitations: Main executable encrypted (cryptid=1); runtime registration, premium gates, hidden-pane access and native override logic are not recovered.
Root-reachable means linked in packaged Root.plist, not proof shown in app or system Settings on device.
Android 6.0.3 versus iOS 3.5 are different release lines; unmapped settings do not prove missing functionality.
